name: harry-potter-fest-monorepo
description: AJ-ASTRIX 2K27 — Harry Potter themed college festival monorepo with 3D Great Hall frontend and Express backend.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
